documents.title: Admin console
documents.text: The admin dashboard shows live Demo-database counts for doctors, specialties, facilities, sessions, bookings, and patients, plus the five AI-feature statuses.

documents.title: Managing doctors
documents.text: From Doctors you can search, add, edit, or delete. Adding needs name, email, specialty, and password. Records are synthetic with no real license. Delete confirms on that page.

documents.title: Sessions and bookings
documents.text: Sessions lists simulated sessions and a form to add one (title, date, time, doctor, capacity). Bookings lists simulated appointments. Specialties and facilities are read from the Demo database.

documents.title: Accounts and specialties
documents.text: Accounts lists Demo patients. Specialties lists all 56 with doctor counts. Facilities lists Latakia display-area demo clinics only.
